column9: On line up NWS light came on at take off point at Lukla. The NWS light came back on even after following the required procedure. Aircraft was taxied out oh the runway to parking bay but further positioning of aircraft was not possible due to nosewheel stuck facing the lift side. Engine was shut down and passengers were disembarked. After consulting with engineering aircraft was pushed forward to allow other aircraft to enter the parking bay
column18: Initial Assessment : Nose Landing gear bracket found crack

column18: Initial assessment : Suspected faulty Relay 8CC                                                 Action Taken : Defective  Relay 8CC was removed and replaced IAW AMM 39-20-04, test operational test carried out IAW AMM 27-40-00, found satisfactory

column9: At 105 DANDA the elevator trim was found to be stuck. Power /airspeed was adjusted to control the aircraft. Checklist was earned out and diverted to KTM. Elevator trim works nose down but doesn't work nose up from both P1 & P2 side. The elevator trim seems to work intermittently
